notes: Files are downloaded by you from the product pages below and registered with `python -m lunaops.acquire register-dem`. Registration reads the embedded CRS, size, units and nodata, computes SHA-256 and records everything in data/dem/registry.json. File names, sizes and download links marked verified were read from the PGDA product pages on verified_utc; PGDA may change them. Several files may share a level (for example the 5 m mosaic and several 5 m site DEMs); finer products are sampled first, then coarser ones. All PGDA files listed here are GeoTIFFs in south polar stereographic X/Y metres, MOON_ME frame of DE421, heights in metres above the 1737.4 km sphere.

validation_products.status: VT-11 resolved from the PDS3 labels (2026-11-10, A10): the value is the fraction of hourly timesteps in which any part of the disc is visible, DN * 0.00004 (DN 25000 = 1), for the Sun and, in the _EARTH product, for Earth's disc; averaged over 18.6 years (PGDA 69). Observer height and the epoch of the 18.6-year span are not documented (assumed 0 m and 2026-01-01). V-09/V-10 use AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608[_EARTH].IMG from the PDS Geosciences node with the 'any' rule (validation/v09_v10_avgvisib.py; provenance in validation/reference/avgvisib/). Their RMSE/bias criteria are provisional and not approved.
